action.description: extract: find claims in text. verify: gather evidence. list: show claims. sources: per-source breakdown. contested: claims waiting on the owner's review. confirm_refutation / dismiss_refutation: the owner's verdict on one.

text.description: extract only: the source text to extract claims from.

source_note_id.description: extract only: id of the note the text came from; links each claim via ASSERTED_IN.

source_context.description: extract only: provenance label stored on each claim (e.g. 'video_learning').

asserted_by.description: extract only: fallback attribution (e.g. the channel) when the text does not name a source.

source_type.description: extract only: the source's tier (primary | reporting | analysis | commentary; empty = commentary). With limits_by_type it sets how many claims to take, and it is stored on each claim and on the source note.

limits_by_type.description: extract only: claims to take per tier, e.g. {primary: 3, reporting: 3, analysis: 1, commentary: 0}. Overrides limit.

probe_every.description: extract only, with limits_by_type: a tier that yields 0 still gives 1 claim from every Nth item, so its sources keep a track record.

exclude_sections.description: extract only: Markdown sections to leave out, by heading prefix (case-insensitive), e.g. a brief's self-report sections. Each runs to the next heading.

claim_id.description: verify: verify one specific claim (omit to sweep the unverified backlog). confirm_refutation / dismiss_refutation: the contested claim.

reason.description: dismiss_refutation: why the contradiction does not hold (kept on the edge).

status.description: list only: filter by epistemic status.

limit.description: extract: max claims (default 5). verify: batch size (default 5). list: max rows (default 20).
